normalization: The Internet Archive's own text layer (_djvu.txt), held under text/ exactly as served, byte for byte: the file's SHA-256 in MANIFEST.sha256 is the hash of the served file, checked against the fetch log. scope: Three volumes, whole. The Geburt der Tragödie itself is seated in its new edition of 1886 (EA-CORPORA-27/03) and is not reseated.
why_seated: The philologist the field refused: his inaugural lecture on Homer and the discipline, his source criticism of Diogenes Laertius, and his Basel introduction to the study of classical philology.
